discovery.geography: Ukraine and international markets on every inhabited continent: Europe, Asia, Africa, North America, South America and Oceania; no Ukraine-only or EU-only source restriction.
discovery.source_registry_status: TARGET_NOT_AUDITED; do not claim 101 sources are connected until an actual deduplicated, accessible and checked registry exists.
discovery.example_media: InVenture (Ukraine); use only after verifying its actual domain, publication, source and relevance.
discovery.verification: For factual project claims trace secondary media to an authoritative primary announcement or official filing. Deduplicate syndications; never invent, imply a crawl, or count unchecked domains as verified sources.
discovery.editorial_scope: Industrial energy and generation, metallurgy, food, logistics, data centers, chemical, agriculture, pharma and waste, including relevant financing and implementation technologies.

homepage_news.selection: Five most recent approved, verified and dated articles; sort by publication_date descending, then stable slug. Never fill a shortfall with unverified or invented news. All approved articles remain accessible through the full news listing.

company_context.executive_quote: Only reproduce a verbatim quotation when present in a verified primary source; include speaker full name, position and source URL. Otherwise use a factual third paragraph without a quotation. Never invent quotations, credentials, project dates or status.

images.absolute_requirement: Every published news item must be accompanied by a relevant, successfully rendered thematic image on homepage, all-news, sector listing and full article. No generic IIG ENERGY banner, empty media slot or unrelated photograph.
images.trademark_free_fallback: If use or depiction of a company name, trademark or logo on a building, machine, sign or image is not authorized, choose a rights-cleared neutral image or generate an original photorealistic silhouette of the relevant factory or industrial equipment WITHOUT any company name, signage, logos or recognizable trade dress. Do not erase a third-party trademark from an existing copyrighted photograph without permission; use a different photograph or independently created original image. Do not imply the generic factory is the actual company facility.
images.sector_photo_fallback: If source photo, logo and other news-specific visual fail relevance, quality, permission or availability checks, use a rights-cleared photograph representative of the article's own sector. If no licensed sector photograph exists, create an original photorealistic sector image. Caption it UA/EN as representative sector imagery or conceptual illustration. A topic-specific diagram is the final safe fallback when no photograph can be supplied.
images.source_photo_rule: Look for an image on every primary-source article and check accompanying press/media usage terms. A source citation or hyperlink at the end of an article attributes information but does NOT by itself grant permission to copy or republish a photograph, logo or embedded image. A photo can be used only if its applicable license, editorial-use permission, or written authorization covers the intended IIG use and required credit is supplied.
images.image_url: Use a verified HTTPS asset or site-relative local asset; never assume a source image exists.
images.alt_text: Provide factual UA and EN alt text identifying a source photograph, company logo, representative sector photograph or conceptual illustration correctly.
images.rights: Record asset origin, copyright owner, license or written permission and any attribution requirements. A publicly visible press photograph or logo is not automatically licensed. Do not hotlink unverified assets, redraw prohibited trademarks or imply endorsement.
images.label: Clearly label representative industry photos and original artwork UA/EN; do not represent them as documentary photographs of the reported project.
images.rendering: Compact responsive 16:9 images with consistent card heights, object-fit:cover for photos and contain for logos; restrained article hero. Render consistently on homepage, all-news, sector cards and article, with descriptive alt, required attribution and image-error fallback to a rights-cleared relevant sector image or original topic-specific artwork.
images.release_gate: Verify that every approved article has a relevant rendered image, rights basis, UA/EN alt and caption, working asset URL and visual checks on home, news, sector and article. Homepage displays exactly five when at least five approved articles exist. Never publish an uncleared logo or photo simply to fill a card.

editorial.navigation: Every published card on home and industry pages links to the full approved article. No hardcoded demo news in public listings. Audit all nine sectors for coverage, valid routing and honest empty states.
